questions.question: Is backing a school bus encouraged or discouraged?

options.text: It should only be done in the morning.

questions.explanation: Backing a school bus is strongly discouraged. Only back the bus if there is no safe alternative. If you must back up, follow all safety rules.

questions.question: During the vehicle inspection test, which item do you NOT need to check?
questions.explanation: During the pre-trip inspection, you check the power steering belt, water pump belt, alternator belt, and air compressor belt if the bus has one. There is no water compressor belt to check.

questions.question: If the driving test route has no railroad crossing, what might happen?

options.text: You will not have to do anything about railroad crossings.
The examiner may ask you to explain how you would cross railroad tracks.
You will have to take a different route.

questions.correctAnswerText: The examiner may ask you to explain how you would cross railroad tracks.
questions.explanation: If the test route does not include a railroad crossing, the examiner may ask you to explain and show the proper steps at a practice location.

questions.question: When making a turn during your driving test, what should you do?

options.text: Use your turn signal only if other cars are around.
Check traffic only in the direction you are turning.

questions.explanation: When making a turn during the test, check traffic in all directions and use your turn signal.

questions.question: Which skill is tested in the basic vehicle control test?
questions.explanation: The basic vehicle control test includes straight line backing, offset back parking on the right and left, parallel parking, and alley docking.

questions.question: Do school buses have ABS?

options.text: School buses have ABS only if young students ride them.

questions.explanation: Most school buses made after 1998 or 1999 have an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS). Many older buses also have ABS.

questions.question: Where is the overhead rearview mirror on a bus?

options.text: On the right side of the bus.
Above the windshield inside the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Above the windshield inside the bus.
questions.explanation: The overhead rearview mirror is mounted above the windshield on the driver's side inside the bus. Use it to watch the students.

questions.question: What should a driver do when dropping off students at school?

options.text: Turn off the engine to secure the bus.
Leave the key in the ignition if leaving the driver's seat.
Read a book while students get off.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off the engine to secure the bus.
questions.explanation: Turn off the engine to secure the bus when unloading students. Remove the key if you leave the driver's seat. Watch the students as they get off the bus.

questions.question: What does the examiner score you on during the driving test?

options.text: How fast you reach your destination.

questions.explanation: The examiner scores you on how well you perform specific driving moves and your overall driving behavior.

questions.question: What does ABS help you do?

options.text: Stop your wheels from locking up.
Count the number of students on the bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop your wheels from locking up.
questions.explanation: An Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) keeps your wheels from locking up when you brake hard on a slippery surface.

questions.question: What will the examiner score you on during the driving test?

options.text: How fast you reach your destination.

questions.explanation: The examiner will score you on your driving skills and how safely you drive. You must obey all traffic signs and signals, follow traffic laws, and avoid accidents and violations.

questions.question: What is a passive railroad crossing?
questions.explanation: A passive railroad crossing has no traffic control devices. The driver must decide whether it is safe to cross the tracks.

questions.question: Except for the straight line backing exercise, how many times can you exit your vehicle to check its position during testing?
questions.explanation: You can exit your vehicle to check its position up to two times during most exercises. For straight line backing, you can only do this once.

questions.question: What should you do when you encounter a railroad crossing during the driving test?

options.text: Pass another vehicle if it is moving too slow.
Get out to check for a train.
Do not change gears while on the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not change gears while on the tracks.
questions.explanation: Do not stop, change gears, pass another vehicle, or change lanes while any part of your vehicle is on the railroad tracks.

questions.question: What should NOT be included in a post-trip inspection?

options.text: Looking for items left on the bus.
Checking for students who are sleeping.

questions.explanation: After a trip, check for sleeping students, lost items, open windows or doors, mechanical problems, and damage. Opening windows is not required for a post-trip inspection.

questions.question: When properly adjusted, what should the flat mirrors on a school bus show?

options.text: The front tires touching the ground.

questions.explanation: The flat mirrors should let you see 200 feet behind the bus, the base of each rear wheel, and the sides of the bus.

questions.question: What should the overhead inside rearview mirror show?
questions.explanation: This mirror should be positioned so you can see all students, including those sitting right behind you.

questions.question: When should mirrors be adjusted on a school bus?
questions.explanation: Always check and adjust all mirrors before you start driving the bus.

questions.question: What happens if you exit your vehicle incorrectly during the basic vehicle control skills test?

options.text: You lose points from your final score.
You automatically fail the entire test.

questions.correctAnswerText: You automatically fail the entire test.
questions.explanation: When exiting your vehicle, you must face it and keep three points of contact at all times. On a bus, hold the handrail. Exiting incorrectly means you automatically fail the test.

questions.question: What must happen if there is a fire on a school bus?

options.text: Students should move to a safe part of the bus.
Students should stay in their seats.

questions.explanation: If there is a fire or risk of fire on the bus, you must get all students off the bus immediately.
